title: The Seal Sings
description: It is too late for wards. The seal on the deepest Vault has begun to SING — a thin, wrong note that carries up through forty feet of stone — and the dead throw themselves against it in a frenzy, as if something on the far side is calling them home. This is the last thing Osric will ask of the living age: go down, hold the antechamber while the note climbs, and see with your own eyes what a hundred years too old is reaching toward. Then come back and tell him whether it can still be stopped.

objectives.desc: Reach the antechamber before the singing seal
Hold the antechamber against the frenzied shades
Carry what you saw at the seal back to Father Osric
